title: UGG: Unified Generative Geometry Model
abstract: arXiv:2611.14440v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Understanding 4D scenes is a core challenge in visual intelligence, requiring models to jointly capture scene geometry, appearance, and dynamics from partial observations. However, existing approaches are subdivided into feedforward models for direct geometric prediction, and generative models for visual synthesis. We introduce UGG, a unified framework for 4D scene understanding that jointly models RGB video and geometric representations such as depth and camera pose. By assigning different noise levels across modalities and time, UGG formulates visual generation and geometric prediction as conditional completion within a single generative model. This flexible formulation enables the model to learn from diverse, heterogeneous datasets with different subsets of geometric and visual annotations. Furthermore, our generative formulation enables inference-time search over multiple plausible scene hypotheses, using geometric evidence extract

translated_abstract: 理解4D场景是视觉智能中的核心挑战，要求模型能够从部分观测中联合捕捉场景的几何、外观与动态。然而，现有方法被细分为两类：用于直接几何预测的前馈模型，以及用于视觉合成的生成模型。我们提出了UGG，一个面向4D场景理解的统一框架，它联合建模RGB视频与几何表示（如深度和相机位姿）。通过在不同模态和时间上分配不同的噪声水平，UGG将视觉生成与几何预测统一表述为单一生成模型内的条件补全任务。这种灵活的表述方式使模型能够从具有不同几何与视觉标注子集的多样化异构数据集中学习。此外，我们的生成式表述支持在推理阶段对多个合理的场景假设进行搜索，并利用提取的几何证据……
tldr: 该论文提出统一生成式几何模型UGG，将RGB视频生成与深度、相机位姿等几何预测统一为单一生成模型中的条件补全任务，实现4D场景理解，并能从异构数据集学习以及在推理时对多个场景假设进行搜索。
en_tdlr: UGG is a unified generative framework for 4D scene understanding that formulates RGB video generation and geometric prediction (e.g., depth and camera pose) as conditional completion within a single generative model, enabling learning from heterogeneous datasets and inference-time search over multiple plausible scene hypotheses.
